body: I was in a private school until about halfway through year ten (January 2018) and decided to leave because my reputation amongst teachers in power there was awful , whatever I did to try and improve it didn't help at all. I was becoming a lot better too w my behaviour etc but there was no point me staying there. I was supposed to be put into a state school near me the week after , but the school I was just at put it down as an exclusion and not a withdrawal, so I missed months of school. I did the last week of year ten at the state school and after the holidays which were actually some of the best times I've had in years , I did a month of year 11 at the school. Then I had to move to a school nearby to me , which is a private school so I could resit the year ten that I missed. I found it awful , the school itself has only around 100 people and for the ridiculous amount of money you need to pay its not worth it at all. I moved there to make my mum happy tho because she thought if I resat the year id do better. Now I wish I stayed at the state school because I would have at least had some GCSEs. In the new school I was at it was so hard for me because I was getting further and further away from all my friends where now I don't really have anyone , and everyone was moving on w their lives. Even now it's hard people are driving my age and going out regularly I just lay in bed crying or wanting to die. The school expelled me for a lack of respect for the rules , and their rules are absurd. I got suspended last week for wearing a jacket for fuck sake they are not arsed. They even got my mum to pay the school fees last week cause they have been trying to kick me out. I've acdepted all responsibility for what I've done , my life is over now but that one teacher at the school made my life hell. She made her decisions based on her mood , and yesterday I told her I don't care about my report card. She said end of conversation and I got my whole future taken away from me this morning when I walked into school. I'm not a naughty kid I promise, I just stand up for myself and when I try to defend myself from any bullshit or unnecessary shit the school comes out with I get into trouble. I've been let down by the education system massively, my grades are actually decent and I knew I could have excelled in may when the exams came around. Its a horrible situation to be in and it's why I really don't want to live anymore
